reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in his DM: he should keep **Friday 30 October at 8:30** free.

The time comes from his own DM with me on 14 October. He said his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team about the Thistle rollout would be on Fridays at 8:30 from then on. Nothing is on his calendar for 26–30 October, so I suggested he block the slot himself. I didn't create an event, since he hadn't asked for one.

The reply stays in his DM, and I didn't share it anywhere else.
